entities.summary: Krzysztof Kazimierz Kosedowski is a retired boxer from Poland, who won the bronze medal in the featherweight division at the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow, Soviet Union. In the semifinals, he was beaten by eventual silver medalist Adolfo Horta of Cuba after a walkover.
